text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On our way back from a day out, Super
Creek
and I are talking about getting
tea together
when...

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Spending a lazy day with your
Umamusume? Talk
about taking it easy.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Um... And you are?

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text: I'm a trainer at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, is that so? Then that must
make the
two of you acquai—

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
That's neither here nor there. Shouldn't
you be
taking better care of your
Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
These first three years of the Twinkle
Series are
the most important to an
Umamusume, right?

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty sure you don't have the time
to be
slacking off like this.

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
The girls may need breaks, but do
trainers?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Of course they do. A trainer would
collapse if
they worked non-stop.
Besides...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My trainer is very considerate of me.
You don't
need to worry about us.

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
That kind of complacent mindset leaves
no room
for an Umamusume to grow.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's right—because you're an
amazing
person.
choice_data_list: 予定はしっかり立てています
甘い考えというわけでは……

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You're always studying so much so you
can do
well to guide me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You're a wonderful trainer. ♪

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...I see. It's none of my business, I
suppose. If
you'll excuse me...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The other trainer storms off in a huff.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Hey. Don't let what that other trainer
said get
to you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We're moving along at our own pace.
Besides...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Maybe she had something troubling her.
She
sounded... really lonely.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I wouldn't give it much thought.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Glad to hear that. Okay, let's relax with
a cup of
tea before heading back! ♪
choice_data_list: 大丈夫、気にしてないよ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Super Creek spends the
rest of the
day walking right by my side
as if to comfort me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My trainer knows me better than I know
myself.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
And all that knowledge and experience
helps me
one way or another.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
So while I appreciate the concern,
there's really
nothing for you to worry
about.

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Well, if the day ever comes that
you
regret those words, don't come
crying to me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The other trainer storms off in a huff.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Are you thinking about what that
other
trainer said to you?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I thought so...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Instead of thinking about what she said,
I hope
you can take my words to heart.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You're always helping me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes, when I'm supposed to be
spoiling
you, I feel like I'm the one who
ends up being
spoiled.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: So you should believe in yourself. Okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Super Creek spends the
rest of the
day walking right by my side
as if to comfort me.
